privacyPolicyDiscription: Protection and security of your personal information is one of the top priorities of **DC Jewellers **. This privacy policy discloses the practices of DC Jewellers  regarding the information collected from users of this website/mobile app. By using this website/mobile app, you agree to accept the terms of this privacy policy as well as the website/mobile app's Terms of Use. By accessing or using this website/mobile app, you expressly consent to the use of our website/mobile app and the disclosure of your personal information in any manner described in this privacy policy. This privacy policy extends to both users who visit the website/mobile app but do not transact business on the website, as well as users who are registered on the website.
